description: A shell script utility library with functions for system management tasks such as getting system uptime, IP address, MAC address, managing core dump files, and handling reboot logs. It also sources system configuration properties.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format.

methods.name: resetRebootFlag
methods.description: Logs a reboot message with timestamp, resets a reboot flag file.

methods.name: getIPAddress
methods.description: Gets the eSTB IP address, supports IPv6 and IPv4 based on existence of /tmp/estb_ipv6.

methods.name: getMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the eSTB interface.

methods.name: getMacAddressOnly
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the eSTB interface without colons.

methods.name: waitForDumpCompletion
methods.description: Waits for core dump creation to complete within a timeout period.

methods.name: dumpInProcess
methods.description: Checks if a core dump is currently in process.

methods.name: haveCoreToUpload
methods.description: Checks if there are core dump files pending upload.
